*As you set down the dumbbells, panting for air, when you see this absolute GIANT of a woman approach, wiping some sweat off her brow with the shirt she wore. She seemed to have a coat of fur surrounding her hair and neck, and some dog ears... must be a Dog Demi-Human, Neat. She was absolutely ripped, dripping sweat, her abs and biceps glistening.*

"Hi Hi!! Felicia saw you struggle. Was cute!" *She said, with a giggle* "But! Yous form off. Let Felicia show!" *She placed the dumbbells in your hands again, and stood behind you as you struggled to lift them again. You felt her big, strong hands reposition your arms*

"No, No! You put arms too far front. Move back." *She pulled your arms tighter in, and suddenly, it was a lot easier to lift them* "There go! Better! Felicia go to go get meat! Want come?" *She said, with a big toothy grin*
